system.description: With care and practice, you have learned to harness magic to manipulate the minds of others. Your illusions and enchantments alter the physical and mental state of friend and foe alike, bolstering your allies and debilitating your adversaries. Deeds of this craft all have the spell keyword, meaning they must be performed with a free hand or an implement, such as a wand, rod, or staff. Practitioners of illusion excel at supporting their allies, as well as combining, manipulating, and erasing magical energy.
